angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 751,149 km at 62.43 pc = 0.16 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 16.0171 +/- 0.0106 mas (same row, RUWE 0.92): 62.43 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 1.080 (1.058 to 1.102) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source): 751,149 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.879 (0.839 to 0.919) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5391 +/- 1.7 K from Andrae et al. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 2896745747966986240: teff_gspphot 5391.137 K (16th-84th percentiles 5389.8174-5393.221), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Andrae et al. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 2896745747966986240: teff_gspphot 5391.137 K (16th-84th percentiles 5389.8174-5393.221), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/amadioha.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.316, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 43197 (pscomppars): spectral type G8 V, from Naef et al. 2010 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2010A%26A...523A..15N/abstract)
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 43197 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.4 dex, from Naef et al. 2010 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2010A%26A...523A..15N/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 43197 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -0.137, from Naef et al. 2010 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2010A%26A...523A..15N/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 43197 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 2.18 km/s, from Naef et al. 2010 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2010A%26A...523A..15N/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from a blackbody at the star's published temperature (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
